# 現在賢劫千佛名經

**ID:** T0447b
**Volume:** T14
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0447b

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This is the second recension (T447b) of the present-aeon thousand-Buddha-names text, preserved only in the CBETA edition without additional canon witnesses. It carries the same alternative title as T446b: 現在賢劫千佛名經(一名「集諸佛大功德山」). The minimal canon attestation (CBETA only, no 【大→宋/元/明】 variants) suggests this recension represents a less widely circulated textual tradition than T447a ([KR6i0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0024)).

**Abstract**

T447b is the less-attested recension of the present-aeon thousand-Buddhas list. Its parallel structure with T446b ([KR6i0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0023)) — same alternative title 集諸佛大功德山, same "orig/CBETA only" attestation — suggests that the "b" recensions of all three aeons (T446b, T447b, T448b) represent a coherent secondary transmission stream, possibly manuscript-based and distinct from the major printed-canon tradition represented by the "a" recensions. See [KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0027) for the complete group.
